appearances.snippet: She has money and connections. She can call Vice President J.D. Vance. She can get the Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to issue a letter on demand, demanding you stop looking into their finances.

verification.notes: Treasury did send a rapid letter in response to an Erika Kirk request for information and the letter helped rebut social-media claims. No source shows that the letter demanded that the public stop researching TPUSA finances, so that characterization is unsupported.
